responsibility: Implements loop induction-variable canonicalization plus complete unrolling and simple peeling for loops with known or estimable trip counts. It can create a canonical countdown IV and replace exit tests for loops with analyzable iteration counts, estimates loop size and profitability for peeling/unrolling, performs the necessary CFG/SSA rewrites, and hosts the pass entry points for ivcanon and both full-unroll variants in the tree loop pipeline.
